subject: FYI mac/pr-1216-fix-backup is a redundant safety copy - do not review or open a PR for it
body: mac/pr-1216-fix-backup (5a270174) is the fix-wave worker's pre-rebuild backup of the #1216 fix; every patch on it is already on the rebuilt pr-1216-fix branch (git cherry: 3 of 3 applied), which lands onto mac/objective-loop-awaiting (#1216) when its chain is green. The Mac's hook forbids force-deleting a local branch and the owner chose to push it to the hub instead; please skip it in your hourly cycle. It can be deleted by anyone once #1216's new head is pushed.
